## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and link the relevant issue and user docs.
Use a clear PR title; GitHub Releases uses merged PR titles as release notes.

## Release label

Add `breaking-change`, `enhancement`, `bug`, `documentation`, or `dependencies`.
Use `skip-release-notes` for staging work or changes with no user-facing effect.
Never edit a changelog. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/telegraphic-dev/a2a-exposed/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pr-titles-and-release-notes).

## Validation

List checks and results, including any unverified work.
